title: Middle East: a $233M round and a brokerage approval
sub: Rounds tracked by Fintiqa and Fintechbits reporting, October 2026.
src: Source: company announcements, Fintechbits reporting. Tracked by Fintiqa.
items: Led by Blue Pool Capital, announced 6 October.
The FSRA gave an in-principle approval on 26 October for brokerage and virtual asset custody.
It is a Financial Services Permission, so Alpaca Middle East cannot yet carry out regulated activities in ADGM.
Alpaca's previous in-principle approval came on 28 September.
